source.generator: Authentic unchanged F124-AK first-admitted 7–15-hop paired graph builder with strictly new cohorts, new nonlinear transformations and opaque per-task public support. Pos/neg have identical topology/token inventories and input/output examples.
source.public_rule_token: opaque rel_task_SHA only; no operator label
source.noise: For first vector, perturb one output bit of one demonstration deterministically among first 8 public examples, same demonstration+bit in both pos/neg; second vector clean; preserve true graph transforms and oracle.
source.ambiguity: First two public examples are repeated input/output demonstrations for first vector, reducing independent information at low support sizes; no graph/key-derived teaching examples; mixed clean/noisy strata.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: Learn source-blind odd modular multiplication or reversible triangular OR-XOR operator from unlabeled demonstrations, with robust one-bit label noise and ambiguous demonstrations. These are outside F124-AK's modular ADD / triangular AND hypothesis class.
Yggdrasil.model: Infer odd multiplier from odd-input example candidates; triangular OR with p=1..4 and q=p+1..5 plus inferred XOR output mask. Rank by mismatch Hamming distance across public demonstration output bits, require best mismatches <=1 and margin against runner-up >=2, else abstain. No explicit rule names from graph, no oracle fallback.
Yggdrasil.selection: Maximum exact paired correctness on new TRAIN, ties lower FP then fewer examples; untouched DEV only after model/protocol fixed.

Wingless.hypothesis: Restrict positive within-hop relative match bonuses without discarding negative competition penalties. Can cap positive bonus to reduce false positive calls while keeping long-chain positive recovery in a single original packed state?
Wingless.model: Original F124-AK within-hop packed competition at beta .5; cap positive bonus at beta * c per hop while preserving full negative penalties, zero alternate node states/cache. cap1 original candidate; one packed 12-bit state/node max64.
Wingless.selection: Max 48 paired TRAIN classification, then min FP, then highest long positive sensitivity, ties prefer original cap1. Freeze before fresh DEV.
